name: Dueling Ground

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Create a 15-foot-radius dueling Sphere and designate two willing occupants. A third creature entering ends it. A target reduced to 0 HP inside, or subjected to an instant-kill effect without damage, becomes Stable, Unconscious at 0 HP, and teleports to the nearest empty space outside. The last remaining target is marked victor. Each slot above 2 permits one more target.
